summary: The PR adds a "clear completed tasks" feature (DELETE /api/todos?completed=true, a repository method, a React Query hook, a confirmation dialog and a page button). I added cases to the existing owner tests and created two new test files. The full backend and frontend suites and both type checks pass.

targets.reason: New deleteCompleted had no test; added a case, which passed with 100% coverage of the file.
behaviours: deleteCompleted calls deleteMany with where completed true
deleteCompleted returns the deleted count, including 0

targets.reason: New DELETE / route had no test; added cases. The existing setup() also needed a deleteCompleted mock, otherwise the type check failed because TodoStore now requires it; no existing assertion changed.
behaviours: DELETE /api/todos?completed=true returns 200 with the deleted count and calls deleteCompleted once
DELETE /api/todos without completed=true, or with another value or an extra or duplicate key, returns 422 and does not call deleteCompleted
the collection delete does not call the single-task delete

targets.reason: New clearCompletedQuerySchema was untested; added accept and reject cases. The file keeps 100% coverage.
behaviours: accepts only completed equal to the string 'true'
rejects an empty query, 'false', '1', a boolean, an array and extra keys

targets.reason: New clearCompleted API call had no test; added one case.
behaviours: clearCompleted sends DELETE to /todos?completed=true and resolves with the deleted count

targets.reason: New component without a test. Line coverage is 100%. The only untaken branch is the 'if (pending) return' guard on line 18, which the disabled buttons make unreachable through the UI.
behaviours: singular and plural confirmation text for the completed count
shows the mutation error and cancel closes without clearing
confirming calls the mutation and reports the deleted count
a failed clear is not reported, the dialog stays open and retry works
locked controls and no mutation while pending or while the page is busy

targets.reason: New hook without a test; covers the cache effects with a real QueryClient.
behaviours: removes completed tasks from the cached list and returns the deleted count
does not create a list when none is cached
keeps the cache and exposes the error when clearing fails
cancels an in-flight list refetch so stale data cannot restore completed tasks

targets.reason: New clear-completed button and dialog wiring had no tests; added cases and a mock of ClearCompletedDialog next to the existing child mocks. TodosPage.tsx has 100% coverage.
behaviours: the Clear completed (n) button shows only when completed tasks exist
the button is disabled and opens nothing while the page is busy
opens the dialog with the completed count and busy state, and closes on cancel without a notice
announces 'Cleared 1 completed task.' for one task and 'Cleared N completed tasks.' otherwise, then closes the dialog

findings.detail: The shared setup() store mock gained a deleteCompleted mock. This is not an assertion change: TodoStore now requires the method, and without it npm run typecheck fails on the existing mock.
